# ============================================================

module NhatKhoaHungPlaque
  extend self

  MODEL_NAME = "BANG_TEN_NHAT_KHOA_HUNG"

  # Kich thuoc tong the (mm) - co the thay doi
  W       = 600.mm
  H_PANEL = 245.mm
  D_PANEL = 18.mm
  BASE_W  = 650.mm
  BASE_D  = 165.mm
  BASE_H  = 22.mm

  def mat(model, name, color, texture_size = nil)
    m = model.materials[name] || model.materials.add(name)
    m.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*color)
    m
  end

  def box(entities, name, x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, material)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name
    e = g.entities

    pts = [
      [x,      y,      z],
      [x + dx, y,      z],
      [x + dx, y + dy, z],
      [x,      y + dy, z]
    ].map { |p| Geom::Point3d.new(*p) }

    f = e.add_face(pts)
    if f
      f.reverse! if f.normal.z < 0
      f.pushpull(dz)
      e.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |face|
        face.material = material
        face.back_material = material
      end
    end
    g
  end

  # Tao thanh hop co tiet dien vuong
  def beam(entities, name, p1, p2, width, depth, material)
    a = Geom::Point3d.new(*p1)
    b = Geom::Point3d.new(*p2)
    v = b - a
    return if v.length < 0.001

    # Dung thanh theo truc X hoac Z, phu hop khung mat dung
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name
    length = v.length
    if v.parallel?(Geom::Vector3d.new(1, 0, 0))
      box(g.entities, name + "_solid",
          [a.x, b.x].min, a.y, a.z - width / 2,
          length, depth, width, material)
    elsif v.parallel?(Geom::Vector3d.new(0, 0, 1))
      box(g.entities, name + "_solid",
          a.x - width / 2, a.y, [a.z, b.z].min,
          width, depth, length, material)
    end
    g
  end

  # Chu noi 3D tren mat dung.
  # Mat truoc cua bang huong ve phia Y am.
  def front_text(entities, name, string, x, z, height,
                 material, bold = true, font = "Arial",
                 extrusion = 0.8.mm)

    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name

    ok = g.entities.add_3d_text(
      string,
      TextAlignCenter,
      font,
      bold,
      false,
      height,
      0.1.mm,
      0,
      true,
      extrusion
    )

    unless ok
      g.erase!
      return nil
    end

    # Chu tao tren mat XY; xoay 90 do de dung tren mat XZ.
    # Sau xoay, truc Z cua chu huong ra phia truoc.
    rotation = Geom::Transformation.rotation(
      ORIGIN, X_AXIS, 90.degrees
    )
    translation = Geom::Transformation.translation(
      Geom::Vector3d.new(x, -0.5.mm, z)
    )
    g.transform!(translation * rotation)

    g.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |face|
      face.material = material
      face.back_material = material
    end
    g
  end

  # Duong tron trang tri nam tren mat dung XZ.
  def circle_front(entities, name, cx, cz, radius, material,
                   segments = 32, thickness = 0.5.mm)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name
    center = Geom::Point3d.new(cx, -0.4.mm, cz)
    normal = Geom::Vector3d.new(0, -1, 0)

    edges = g.entities.add_circle(center, normal, radius, segments)
    face = g.entities.add_face(edges)
    if face
      face.material = material
      face.pushpull(thickness)
      g.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |f|
        f.material = material
        f.back_material = material
      end
    end
    g
  end

  # Mot canh hoa cach dieu, lap thanh dai trang tri.
  def ornament(entities, x, z, scale, gold, index)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = "Hoa_tiet_vien_#{index}"

    # Hai cung tron nho va mot tam giac kim loai cach dieu
    center = Geom::Point3d.new(x, -0.6.mm, z)
    normal = Geom::Vector3d.new(0, -1, 0)

    [-1, 1].each do |side|
      c = Geom::Point3d.new(
        x + side * 2.0.mm * scale, -0.6.mm, z
      )
      edges = g.entities.add_circle(
        c, normal, 2.2.mm * scale, 12
      )
      edges.each { |edge| edge.soft = true if edge.valid? }
    end

    # Duong trang tri dang chu S don gian
    pts = [
      Geom::Point3d.new(x - 4.mm * scale, -0.6.mm, z),
      Geom::Point3d.new(x - 1.mm * scale, -0.6.mm, z + 2.mm * scale),
      Geom::Point3d.new(x + 1.mm * scale, -0.6.mm, z - 2.mm * scale),
      Geom::Point3d.new(x + 4.mm * scale, -0.6.mm, z)
    ]
    g.entities.add_curve(pts)

    g.entities.grep(Sketchup::Edge).each do |edge|
      edge.material = gold
    end
    g
  end

  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation("Dung bang ten Nhat Khoa Hung", true)

    # Vat lieu
    wood       = mat(model, "Go_do_ruou",       [92, 15, 25])
    wood_light = mat(model, "Go_do_sang",       [130, 28, 38])
    gold       = mat(model, "Vang_kim_loai",    [224, 184, 42])
    gold_light = mat(model, "Vang_sang",        [255, 222, 92])
    gold_dark  = mat(model, "Vang_vien_dam",    [126, 92, 19])
    blue       = mat(model, "Xanh_logo_chu",    [15, 37, 135])
    green      = mat(model, "Xanh_la_logo",     [25, 120, 63])
    red        = mat(model, "Do_chu_KIM_NHO",   [198, 15, 18])
    white      = mat(model, "Trang_vien_chu",   [255, 241, 190])
    black      = mat(model, "Den_nau",          [53, 28, 12])

    # Xoa group cu neu chay lai
    old = model.entities.grep(Sketchup::Group).find do |g|
      g.name == MODEL_NAME
    end
    old.erase! if old && old.valid?

    root = model.entities.add_group
    root.name = MODEL_NAME
    e = root.entities

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. DE GO NHIEU CAP
    # Mat truoc la Y am, chieu cao Z duong
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    box(e, "De_go_cap_duoi",
        -BASE_W / 2, 0, 0,
        BASE_W, BASE_D, BASE_H, wood)

    box(e, "De_go_cap_tren",
        -310.mm, 12.mm, BASE_H,
        620.mm, 135.mm, 28.mm, wood_light)

    # Thanh vien vang tren de
    box(e, "Nep_vang_trang_tri_de",
        -300.mm, 8.mm, 47.mm,
        600.mm, 5.mm, 12.mm, gold)

    box(e, "Nep_vang_sang",
        -300.mm, 7.mm, 58.mm,
        600.mm, 4.mm, 1.8.mm, gold_light)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. KHUNG BANG DUNG
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    panel_z = 72.mm
    panel_y = 38.mm
    panel_w = W
    panel_h = H_PANEL
    panel_front_y = panel_y

    # Than bang va mat vang
    box(e, "Than_khung_go",
        -panel_w / 2, panel_y, panel_z,
        panel_w, D_PANEL, panel_h, wood)

    box(e, "Mat_bang_vang",
        -panel_w / 2 + 8.mm,
        panel_y - 0.5.mm,
        panel_z + 8.mm,
        panel_w - 16.mm,
        1.2.mm,
        panel_h - 16.mm,
        gold)

    # Vien vang ngoai
    frame = 5.mm
    y_frame = panel_y - 1.2.mm
    z0 = panel_z + 5.mm
    inner_w = panel_w - 10.mm
    inner_h = panel_h - 10.mm

    box(e, "Vien_vang_duoi",
        -inner_w / 2, y_frame, z0,
        inner_w, 2.mm, frame, gold_light)

    box(e, "Vien_vang_tren",
        -inner_w / 2, y_frame, z0 + inner_h - frame,
        inner_w, 2.mm, frame, gold_light)

    box(e, "Vien_vang_trai",
        -inner_w / 2, y_frame, z0,
        frame, 2.mm, inner_h, gold_light)

    box(e, "Vien_vang_phai",
        inner_w / 2 - frame, y_frame, z0,
        frame, 2.mm, inner_h, gold_light)

    # Vien trong mau vang dam
    box(e, "Vien_trong_duoi",
        -275.mm, panel_y - 1.8.mm, panel_z + 29.mm,
        550.mm, 1.5.mm, 1.5.mm, gold_dark)

    box(e, "Vien_trong_tren",
        -275.mm, panel_y - 1.8.mm, panel_z + 214.mm,
        550.mm, 1.5.mm, 1.5.mm, gold_dark)

    box(e, "Vien_trong_trai",
        -275.mm, panel_y - 1.8.mm, panel_z + 29.mm,
        1.5.mm, 1.5.mm, 185.mm, gold_dark)

    box(e, "Vien_trong_phai",
        273.5.mm, panel_y - 1.8.mm, panel_z + 29.mm,
        1.5.mm, 1.5.mm, 185.mm, gold_dark)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. HOA TIET LAP LAI QUANH VIEN
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Dai tren va duoi
    (0..54).each do |i|
      x = -265.mm + i * 9.8.mm
      ornament(e, x, panel_z + 20.mm, 0.7, gold_light, i)
      ornament(e, x, panel_z + 222.mm, 0.7, gold_light, i + 100)
    end

    # Hai dai doc
    (0..18).each do |i|
      z = panel_z + 32.mm + i * 9.8.mm
      ornament(e, -285.mm, z, 0.7, gold_light, i + 200)
      ornament(e,  285.mm, z, 0.7, gold_light, i + 300)
    end

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. CHU NOI 3D
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Logo va ten don vi
    front_text(e, "Ten_cong_ty",
      "NHAT KHOA HUNG",
      65.mm, panel_z + 177.mm, 27.mm,
      blue, true, "Arial", 0.8.mm)

    front_text(e, "Chi_nhanh",
      "CHI NHANH VINH LONG",
      65.mm, panel_z + 149.mm, 17.mm,
      blue, true, "Arial", 0.6.mm)

    front_text(e, "Chuc_danh",
      "GIAM DOC",
      0.mm, panel_z + 103.mm, 19.mm,
      blue, true, "Times New Roman", 0.8.mm)

    front_text(e, "Ten_giam_doc",
      "KIM NHO",
      0.mm, panel_z + 42.mm, 47.mm,
      red, true, "Arial", 1.2.mm)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. LOGO HOA CACH DIEU
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    logo_x = -225.mm
    logo_z = panel_z + 171.mm
    circle_front(e, "Logo_vong_ngoai",
      logo_x, logo_z, 23.mm, green, 48, 0.5.mm)

    circle_front(e, "Logo_vong_trong",
      logo_x, logo_z, 17.mm, gold, 48, 0.4.mm)

    # 5 canh hoa tao bang cac duong tron giao nhau
    petal_radius = 9.mm
    5.times do |i|
      angle = i * 72.degrees - 90.degrees
      px = logo_x + Math.cos(angle) * 10.mm
      pz = logo_z + Math.sin(angle) * 10.mm

      circle_front(e, "Logo_canh_hoa_#{i + 1}",
        px, pz, petal_radius, blue, 32, 0.7.mm)
    end

    circle_front(e, "Logo_nhu hoa",
      logo_x, logo_z, 3.mm, gold_light, 24, 0.8.mm)

    front_text(e, "Logo_ten",
      "NHAT KHOA HUNG",
      logo_x, panel_z + 143.mm, 6.mm,
      blue, true, "Times New Roman", 0.3.mm)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 6. DUONG PHAN CACH TRANG TRI
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    box(e, "Duong_ngang_trang_tri",
        -110.mm, panel_y - 1.mm, panel_z + 130.mm,
        220.mm, 0.8.mm, 0.8.mm, gold_light)

    # Cac nut tron trang tri tren duong ngang
    [-45, -30, -15, 0, 15, 30, 45].each_with_index do |offset, i|
      circle_front(e, "Nut_trang_tri_#{i}",
        offset.mm, panel_z + 130.mm,
        1.8.mm, gold_light, 16, 0.4.mm)
    end

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 7. HOAN TAT
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    model.selection.clear
    model.selection.add(root)
    model.active_view.zoom_extents
    model.commit_operation

    puts "Da tao xong mo hinh: #{MODEL_NAME}"
    root
  rescue => ex
    model.abort_operation
    puts "Loi khi dung bang ten: #{ex.message}"
    puts ex.backtrace
    raise
  end
end

      [0.mm, 0.mm, 0.mm],
      [300.mm, 0.mm, 0.mm],
      [300.mm, 200.mm, 0.mm],
      [0.mm, 200.mm, 0.mm]

    base_face = entities.add_face(base_pts)

    base_group.material = "Gray"

    # Tạo bề mặt biển

      [0.mm, 0.mm, -25.mm],
      [300.mm, 0.mm, -25.mm],

      [-5.mm, -5.mm, -25.mm],
      [305.mm, -5.mm, -25.mm],
      [305.mm, 205.mm, -25.mm],

    border_face = entities.add_face(border_pts)

    border_group.material = "Gold"

    model.commit_operation

# ============================================================

module ADMAKE_Lightbox
  extend self

  # ---------- VAT LIEU ----------
  def mat(model, name, rgb)
    m = model.materials[name] || model.materials.add(name)
    m.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*rgb)
    m
  end

  # ---------- HOP CHU NHAT ----------
  def box(ents, name, x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, material)
    g = ents.add_group
    g.name = name
    e = g.entities

    pts = [
      [x, y, z], [x + dx, y, z],
      [x + dx, y + dy, z], [x, y + dy, z]
    ].map { |p| Geom::Point3d.new(*p) }

    f = e.add_face(pts)
    if f
      f.reverse! if f.normal.z < 0
      f.pushpull(dz)
      e.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |face|
        face.material = material
        face.back_material = material
      end
    end

    g
  end

  # ---------- HOP DEN BO GOC ----------
  # Mat truoc nam tren mat phang XZ, truc chieu sau la Y.
  def rounded_panel(ents, name, cx, cy, cz,
                    width, height, depth, radius,
                    face_mat, side_mat)

    g = ents.add_group
    g.name = name
    e = g.entities

    hw = width / 2.0
    hh = height / 2.0
    r = [[radius, hw - 1.mm, hh - 1.mm].min, 1.mm].max
    seg = 12

    # Tao duong bao bo goc trong mat phang XZ
    corners = [
      [cx + hw - r, cz + hh - r, 0],
      [cx - hw + r, cz + hh - r, 90],
      [cx - hw + r, cz - hh + r, 180],
      [cx + hw - r, cz - hh + r, 270]
    ]

    # Goc phan tu duoc tao theo thu tu quanh chu vi
    points = []
    [
      [cx + hw - r, cz + hh - r, 0, 90],
      [cx - hw + r, cz + hh - r, 90, 180],
      [cx - hw + r, cz - hh + r, 180, 270],
      [cx + hw - r, cz - hh + r, 270, 360]
    ].each do |ox, oz, a0, a1|
      (0..seg).each do |i|
        a = (a0 + (a1 - a0) * i.to_f / seg) * Math::PI / 180
        points << Geom::Point3d.new(
          ox + r * Math.cos(a),
          cy,
          oz + r * Math.sin(a)
        )
      end
    end

    face = e.add_face(points)
    return g unless face

    # Huong extrude ve phia sau
    face.reverse! if face.normal.y > 0
    face.pushpull(depth)

    # Gan vat lieu mat truoc va mat ben
    e.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |f|
      center_y = f.bounds.center.y
      if (center_y - cy).abs < 0.01
        f.material = face_mat
        f.back_material = face_mat
      else
        f.material = side_mat
        f.back_material = side_mat
      end
    end

    g
  end

  # ---------- THANH THEP HOP ----------
  def steel_bar(ents, name, p1, p2, size, material)
    a = Geom::Point3d.new(*p1)
    b = Geom::Point3d.new(*p2)
    v = b - a
    return if v.length < 0.1

    axis = v.normalize
    ref = axis.parallel?(Z_AXIS) ? X_AXIS : Z_AXIS
    u = axis.cross(ref).normalize
    w = axis.cross(u).normalize

    s = size / 2.0

    pts = [
      a.offset(u, -s).offset(w, -s),
      a.offset(u,  s).offset(w, -s),
      a.offset(u,  s).offset(w,  s),
      a.offset(u, -s).offset(w,  s)
    ]

    g = ents.add_group
    g.name = name
    f = g.entities.add_face(pts)

    if f
      f.reverse! if f.normal.dot(axis) < 0
      f.pushpull(v.length)
      g.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |face|
        face.material = material
        face.back_material = material
      end
    end

    g
  end

  # ---------- VIEN NHOM BAO QUANH MAT DEN ----------
  def aluminum_frame(ents, name, cx, cy, cz,
                     width, height, radius, tube_size, material)

    g = ents.add_group
    g.name = name
    e = g.entities

    hw = width / 2.0
    hh = height / 2.0
    r = radius
    n = 16
    pts = []

    [
      [cx + hw - r, cz + hh - r, 0, 90],
      [cx - hw + r, cz + hh - r, 90, 180],
      [cx - hw + r, cz - hh + r, 180, 270],
      [cx + hw - r, cz - hh + r, 270, 360]
    ].each do |ox, oz, a0, a1|
      (0..n).each do |i|
        a = (a0 + (a1-a0)*i.to_f/n) * Math::PI / 180
        pts << Geom::Point3d.new(
          ox + r*Math.cos(a), cy,
          oz + r*Math.sin(a)
        )
      end
    end

    # Ve duong vien tren mat truoc
    pts.each_with_index do |p, i|
      e.add_line(p, pts[(i+1) % pts.length])
    end

    # Tao vien day bang cac doan thanh nho
    pts.each_with_index do |p, i|
      q = pts[(i+1) % pts.length]
      v = q - p
      next if v.length < 0.1

      # Thanh profile vuong nho, bo tri theo chu vi
      axis = v.normalize
      ref = Z_AXIS
      ref = X_AXIS if axis.parallel?(ref)
      u = axis.cross(ref).normalize
      w = axis.cross(u).normalize
      s = tube_size / 2.0

      corners = [
        p.offset(u,-s).offset(w,-s),
        p.offset(u, s).offset(w,-s),
        p.offset(u, s).offset(w, s),
        p.offset(u,-s).offset(w, s)
      ]

      bar = e.add_group
      f = bar.entities.add_face(corners)
      if f
        f.reverse! if f.normal.dot(axis) < 0
        f.pushpull(v.length)
        bar.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |ff|
          ff.material = material
          ff.back_material = material
        end
      end
    end

    g
  end

  # ---------- CHAY DUNG MO HINH ----------
  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('ADMAKE - Cum hop den mica', true)

    white = mat(model, 'Mica trang sua', [246, 247, 245])
    silver = mat(model, 'Nhom anod bac', [175, 181, 184])
    steel = mat(model, 'Thep hop xam', [85, 91, 94])
    dark = mat(model, 'Than hop den', [55, 59, 61])

    root = model.active_entities.add_group
    root.name = 'CUM HOP DEN MICA - ADMAKE'
    e = root.entities

    # ===== THONG SO CO THE DIEU CHINH =====
    panel_w = 800.mm
    panel_h = 800.mm
    panel_depth = 100.mm
    corner_r = 100.mm
    frame_t = 18.mm

    panel_count = 5
    spacing = 150.mm

    stand_w = 500.mm
    stand_d = 700.mm
    stand_h = 850.mm
    foot_h = 40.mm
    steel_size = 40.mm

    # ===== CHAN DE =====
    z0 = 0

    # Khung de chu nhat
    steel_bar(e, 'De truoc trai',
      [-stand_w/2, -stand_d/2, z0],

# ============================================================

module Lop66Sign
  extend self

  MODEL_NAME = "LOP66_SIGN_3D"

  # ---------------- THONG SO ----------------
  W = 6000.mm
  H = 1200.mm
  PANEL_T = 25.mm
  FRAME_T = 30.mm
  FRAME_D = 35.mm

  INFO_H = 190.mm
  TITLE_H = 410.mm
  TITLE_D = 22.mm
  SMALL_D = 5.mm

  # ---------------- VAT LIEU ----------------
  def mat(model, name, rgb)
    m = model.materials[name] || model.materials.add(name)
    m.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*rgb)
    m
  end

  def paint(group, material)
    group.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |f|
      f.material = material
      f.back_material = material
    end
  end

  # ---------------- KHOI HOP ----------------
  def box(entities, name, x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, material)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name

    pts = [
      [x, y, z],
      [x + dx, y, z],
      [x + dx, y + dy, z],
      [x, y + dy, z]
    ].map { |p| Geom::Point3d.new(*p) }

    face = g.entities.add_face(pts)

    if face
      face.reverse! if face.normal.z < 0
      face.pushpull(dz)
      paint(g, material)
    end

    g
  end

  # ---------------- CHU NOI 3D ----------------
  # Text duoc tao tren XY, sau do xoay thanh mat XZ.
  # Mat truoc huong Y am.
  def text3d(entities, name, string, cx, cz, front_y,
             height, font, bold, material, depth)

    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name

    success = g.entities.add_3d_text(
      string,
      TextAlignCenter,
      font,
      bold,
      false,
      height,
      0.0,
      0,
      true,
      depth
    )

    unless success
      puts "Khong tao duoc text: #{string}"
      g.erase!
      return nil
    end

    # Xoay chu dung tren mat bang
    rotation = Geom::Transformation.rotation(
      ORIGIN, X_AXIS, 90.degrees
    )
    g.transform!(rotation)

    bb = g.bounds
    center_x = (bb.min.x + bb.max.x) / 2.0
    center_z = (bb.min.z + bb.max.z) / 2.0

    # Can mat chu ve phia truoc bang
    delta_y = front_y - bb.min.y

    translation = Geom::Transformation.translation(
      Geom::Vector3d.new(
        cx - center_x,
        delta_y,
        cz - center_z
      )
    )
    g.transform!(translation)

    paint(g, material)
    g
  end

  # ---------------- DUONG THANH ----------------
  def rail(entities, name, x1, z1, x2, z2,
           width, y, depth, material)

    dx = x2 - x1
    dz = z2 - z1
    length = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
    return nil if length < 0.1.mm

    angle = Math.atan2(dz, dx)
    g = box(
      entities, name,
      x1, y, z1 - width / 2.0,
      length, depth, width, material
    )

    # Xoay thanh quanh diem dau
    tr = Geom::Transformation.rotation(
      Geom::Point3d.new(x1, y, z1),
      Y_AXIS,
      -angle
    )

    g.transform!(tr)
    g
  end

  # ---------------- VONG TRON TREN MAT XZ ----------------
  def ring_lines(entities, name, cx, cz, radius, y, material)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name

    center = Geom::Point3d.new(cx, y, cz)
    normal = Geom::Vector3d.new(0, -1, 0)

    g.entities.add_circle(center, normal, radius, 48)

    g.entities.grep(Sketchup::Edge).each do |edge|
      edge.material = material
    end

    g
  end

  # ---------------- ICON LOP XE ----------------
  def tire_icon(entities, cx, cz, radius, y, black, grey, orange)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = "04_Banh_xe_3D"

    # Cac duong tron mo phong lop va mam
    ring_lines(g.entities, "Lop_ngoai",
               cx, cz, radius, y, grey)

    ring_lines(g.entities, "Thanh_lop",
               cx, cz, radius * 0.88, y - 1.mm, black)

    ring_lines(g.entities, "Vien_mam",
               cx, cz, radius * 0.58, y - 2.mm, grey)

    ring_lines(g.entities, "Tam_mam",
               cx, cz, radius * 0.45, y - 3.mm, orange)

    # Gai lop dang thanh ngan theo chu vi
    24.times do |i|
      angle = 2.0 * Math::PI * i / 24.0
      r1 = radius * 0.91
      r2 = radius * 0.99

      x1 = cx + r1 * Math.cos(angle)
      z1 = cz + r1 * Math.sin(angle)
      x2 = cx + r2 * Math.cos(angle + 0.06)
      z2 = cz + r2 * Math.sin(angle + 0.06)

      rail(
        g.entities, "Gai_lop_#{i + 1}",
        x1, z1, x2, z2,
        5.mm, y - 2.mm, 2.mm, black
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # ---------------- ICON MAM XE ----------------
  def wheel_icon(entities, cx, cz, radius, y, grey, white)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = "06_Icon_mam_xe"

    ring_lines(g.entities, "Mam_vien",
               cx, cz, radius, y, grey)

    ring_lines(g.entities, "Mam_trong",
               cx, cz, radius * 0.76, y - 1.mm, white)

    ring_lines(g.entities, "Bau_mam",
               cx, cz, radius * 0.24, y - 2.mm, grey)

    # 8 nan mam
    8.times do |i|
      angle = i * 2.0 * Math::PI / 8
      x1 = cx + radius * 0.22 * Math.cos(angle)
      z1 = cz + radius * 0.22 * Math.sin(angle)
      x2 = cx + radius * 0.72 * Math.cos(angle + 0.12)
      z2 = cz + radius * 0.72 * Math.sin(angle + 0.12)

      rail(
        g.entities, "Nan_mam_#{i + 1}",
        x1, z1, x2, z2,
        8.mm, y - 2.mm, 2.mm, grey
      )
    end

    g
  end

  # ---------------- DUNG BANG ----------------
  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation("LOP 66 - Bang quang cao 3D", true)

    begin
      # Vat lieu
      black = mat(model, "Nen_den_than",
                  [24, 24, 29])

      dark = mat(model, "Khung_thep",
                 [45, 47, 50])

      orange = mat(model, "Vang_cam",
                   [255, 167, 0])

      yellow = mat(model, "Vang_sang",
                   [255, 190, 20])

      white = mat(model, "Trang",
                  [244, 244, 240])

      grey = mat(model, "Nhom_bac",
                 [165, 169, 175])

      tyre_black = mat(model, "Cao_su",
                       [32, 32, 34])

      # Xoa model cu neu chay lai
      model.entities.grep(Sketchup::Group).each do |g|
        g.erase! if g.name == MODEL_NAME
      end

      root = model.entities.add_group
      root.name = MODEL_NAME
      e = root.entities

      half_w = W / 2.0
      front_y = -PANEL_T

      # ======================================================
      # 1. TAM NEN DEN
      # ======================================================
      box(
        e, "01_Tam_nen_den",
        -half_w, -PANEL_T, 0,
        W, PANEL_T, H,
        black
      )

      # ======================================================
      # 2. VIEN KHUNG
      # ======================================================
      box(e, "Vien_tren",
          -half_w, -PANEL_T - FRAME_D, H - FRAME_T,
          W, FRAME_D, FRAME_T, orange)

      box(e, "Vien_duoi",
          -half_w, -PANEL_T - FRAME_D, 0,
          W, FRAME_D, FRAME_T, orange)

      box(e, "Vien_trai",
          -half_w, -PANEL_T - FRAME_D, 0,
          FRAME_T, FRAME_D, H, orange)

      box(e, "Vien_phai",
          half_w - FRAME_T, -PANEL_T - FRAME_D, 0,
          FRAME_T, FRAME_D, H, orange)

      # ======================================================
      # 3. CHU LOP 66
      # ======================================================
      text3d(
        e, "03_CHU_LOP_66",
        "LOP 66",
        -400.mm, 720.mm,
        front_y - 3.mm,
        TITLE_H,
        "Arial",
        true,
        yellow,
        TITLE_D
      )

      # ======================================================
      # 4. HINH LOP XE BEN TRAI
      # ======================================================
      tire_icon(
        e,
        -2250.mm, 650.mm,
        260.mm,
        front_y - 3.mm,
        tyre_black, grey, orange
      )

      # ======================================================
      # 5. HAI ICON MAM XE BEN PHAI
      # ======================================================
      wheel_icon(
        e,
        1050.mm, 760.mm,
        115.mm,
        front_y - 3.mm,
        grey, white
      )

      wheel_icon(
        e,
        2200.mm, 760.mm,
        115.mm,
        front_y - 3.mm,
        grey, white
      )

      # ======================================================
      # 6. CHU LOP XE CHINH HANG
      # ======================================================
      text3d(
        e, "06_Lop_xe_1",
        "LOP XE",
        1400.mm, 730.mm,
        front_y - 3.mm,
        95.mm,
        "Arial",
        true,
        white,
        SMALL_D
      )

      text3d(
        e, "06_Chinh_hang_1",
        "CHINH HANG",
        1400.mm, 630.mm,
        front_y - 3.mm,
        50.mm,
        "Arial",
        true,
        orange,
        SMALL_D
      )

      text3d(
        e, "07_Lop_xe_2",
        "LOP XE",
        2500.mm, 730.mm,
        front_y - 3.mm,
        95.mm,
        "Arial",
        true,
        white,
        SMALL_D
      )

      text3d(
        e, "07_Chinh_hang_2",
        "CHINH HANG",
        2500.mm, 630.mm,
        front_y - 3.mm,
        50.mm,
        "Arial",
        true,
        orange,
        SMALL_D
      )

      # ======================================================
      # 7. DAI THONG TIN DUOI
      # ======================================================
      box(
        e, "08_Dai_thong_tin_trang",
        -half_w, -PANEL_T - 1.mm, 0,
        W, 2.mm, INFO_H,
        white
      )

      # Dia chi
      text3d(
        e, "09_Dia_chi",
        "66 DINH TIEN HOANG, BMT, DAK LAK",
        -1350.mm, 95.mm,
        -PANEL_T - 4.mm,
        55.mm,
        "Arial",
        true,
        dark,

      )

      # So dien thoai

          e, "Khung_sau_dung_#{i + 1}",
          x, back_y, 50.mm,
          tube, tube, H - 100.mm, dark

      # ======================================================
      # 9. HOAN TAT
      # ======================================================
      model.selection.clear

      puts "Loi: #{error.message}"
      puts error.backtrace
      raise
    end
  end

# ============================================================

module ADMAKE_BienBaoDuAn
  extend self

  W = 3000.mm
  H = 1800.mm
  THICKNESS = 35.mm
  POST_H = 3500.mm
  POST_SIZE = 60.mm
  FRAME = 25.mm
  TEXT_DEPTH = 3.mm

  def material(name, rgb)
    mats = Sketchup.active_model.materials
    m = mats[name] || mats.add(name)
    m.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*rgb)
    m
  end

  def block(entities, name, x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, mat)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name

    pts = [
      [x,      y,      z],
      [x + dx, y,      z],
      [x + dx, y + dy, z],
      [x,      y + dy, z]
    ].map { |p| Geom::Point3d.new(p) }

    f = g.entities.add_face(pts)
    if f
      f.material = mat
      f.back_material = mat
      f.pushpull(dz)
    end
    g
  end

  def text3d(entities, string, x, y, z, height, mat, bold = true)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = "Chu_#{string.tr(" ", "_")}"

    ok = g.entities.add_3d_text(
      string,
      1,
      "Arial",
      bold,
      false,
      height,
      0,
      0,
      true,
      TEXT_DEPTH
    )

    unless ok
      g.erase!
      return nil
    end

    # Chu tao tren mat XY, xoay dung len mat bien.
    g.transform!(
      Geom::Transformation.translation([x, y, z]) *
      Geom::Transformation.rotation(ORIGIN, X_AXIS, 90.degrees)
    )

    g.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |f|
      f.material = mat
      f.back_material = mat
    end

    g
  end

  def run
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation("ADMAKE Bien Bao Du An", true)

    begin
      root = model.active_entities.add_group
      root.name = "BIEN_BAO_DOI_SAN_XUAT_KO_SIER_II"
      e = root.entities

      blue = material("Nen_xanh_duong", [20, 65, 175])
      white = material("Nen_trang", [245, 246, 248])
      red = material("Chu_do", [177, 42, 49])
      navy = material("Chu_xanh_dam", [20, 50, 105])
      silver = material("Nhom_bac", [175, 185, 192])
      steel = material("Thep_tru", [135, 145, 150])
      concrete = material("Be_tong_mong", [145, 145, 140])

      half_w = W / 2.0
      z0 = 1800.mm
      front_y = -THICKNESS / 2.0 - 2.mm

      # ------------------------------------------------
      # MONG BE TONG VA TRU THEP
      # ------------------------------------------------
      [-1, 1].each do |side|
        px = side * (half_w - 100.mm)

        block(
          e, "Mong_tru_#{side}",
          px - 130.mm, -130.mm, 0,
          260.mm, 260.mm, 400.mm, concrete
        )

        block(
          e, "Tru_thep_#{side}",
          px - POST_SIZE / 2.0,
          -POST_SIZE / 2.0,
          400.mm,
          POST_SIZE, POST_SIZE,
          POST_H - 400.mm, steel
        )

        block(
          e, "Nap_tru_#{side}",
          px - POST_SIZE / 2.0,
          -POST_SIZE / 2.0,
          POST_H,
          POST_SIZE, POST_SIZE, 5.mm, silver
        )
      end

      # ------------------------------------------------
      # TAM BIEN CHINH
      # ------------------------------------------------
      block(
        e, "Tam_bien_nen",
        -half_w, -THICKNESS / 2.0, z0,
        W, THICKNESS, H, blue
      )

      # Khu vuc noi dung phia duoi
      lower_h = 700.mm
      block(
        e, "Nen_thong_tin_trang",
        -half_w + FRAME,
        front_y,
        z0 + FRAME,
        W - 2 * FRAME, 3.mm,
        lower_h, white
      )

      # Dai ngan cach xanh
      block(
        e, "Duong_phan_cach",
        -half_w + FRAME,
        front_y - 4.mm,
        z0 + lower_h + FRAME,
        W - 2 * FRAME, 3.mm, 15.mm, white
      )

      # ------------------------------------------------
      # KHUNG VIEN NHOM
      # ------------------------------------------------
      block(e, "Vien_tren",
        -half_w, -THICKNESS / 2.0 - 5.mm,
        z0 + H - FRAME,
        W, 5.mm, FRAME, silver)

      block(e, "Vien_duoi",
        -half_w, -THICKNESS / 2.0 - 5.mm,
        z0,
        W, 5.mm, FRAME, silver)

      block(e, "Vien_trai",
        -half_w, -THICKNESS / 2.0 - 5.mm,
        z0,
        FRAME, 5.mm, H, silver)

      block(e, "Vien_phai",
        half_w - FRAME, -THICKNESS / 2.0 - 5.mm,
        z0,
        FRAME, 5.mm, H, silver)

      # ------------------------------------------------
      # CHU TIEU DE NOI
      # ------------------------------------------------
      text3d(
        e, "ĐỘI SẢN XUẤT",
        0, front_y - 8.mm,
        z0 + H - 450.mm,
        180.mm, red, true
      )

      text3d(
        e, "KÔ SIÊR II",
        0, front_y - 8.mm,
        z0 + H - 800.mm,
        180.mm, red, true
      )

      text3d(
        e, "ĐC: TỔ LIÊN GIA 19, B. KÔ SIÊR, P. BUÔN MA THUỘT, ĐẮK LẮK",
        0, front_y - 8.mm,
        z0 + H - 970.mm,
        35.mm, navy, true
      )

      # ------------------------------------------------
      # KHU VUC THONG TIN BEN DUOI
      # ------------------------------------------------
      # Cot trai
      text3d(
        e, "ĐƠN VỊ CUNG ỨNG",
        -W / 4.0, front_y - 8.mm,
        z0 + 570.mm,
        45.mm, navy, true
      )

      text3d(
        e, "PHÂN BÓN & THUỐC BVTV",
        -W / 4.0, front_y - 8.mm,
        z0 + 460.mm,
        40.mm, navy, true
      )

      text3d(
        e, "BACONCO",
        -W / 4.0, front_y - 8.mm,
        z0 + 280.mm,
        32.mm, navy, true
      )

      # Cot phai
      text3d(
        e, "ĐƠN VỊ TƯ VẤN KỸ THUẬT",
        W / 4.0, front_y - 8.mm,
        z0 + 570.mm,
        42.mm, navy, true
      )

      text3d(
        e, "& CUNG ỨNG VẬT TƯ",
        W / 4.0, front_y - 8.mm,
        z0 + 485.mm,
        42.mm, navy, true
      )

      text3d(
        e, "NPP THÀNH DŨNG",
        W / 4.0, front_y - 8.mm,
        z0 + 300.mm,
        68.mm, red, true
      )

      text3d(
        e, "ĐT: 0983 00 47 53",
        W / 4.0, front_y - 8.mm,
        z0 + 100.mm,
        38.mm, navy, true
      )

      # ------------------------------------------------
      # HOAN TAT
      # ------------------------------------------------
      model.selection.clear
      model.selection.add(root)
      model.active_view.zoom_extents
      model.commit_operation

      UI.messagebox(
        "Da dung xong bien bao 3D.\n" \
        "Bang: 3000 x 1800 mm.\n" \
        "Hay kiem tra font chu va chinh lai kich thuoc theo hien truong."
      )

    rescue => ex
      model.abort_operation
      UI.messagebox("Loi Ruby: #{ex.message}")
    end
  end
end

require 'sketchup.rb'

module XeDienThuHien3D
  extend self

  # ---------------- THÔNG SỐ MÔ HÌNH ----------------
  W       = 5000.mm
  H       = 1500.mm
  THICK   = 80.mm
  BOTTOM  = 2200.mm
  TOP     = BOTTOM + H
  POST_H  = 3900.mm
  POST_D  = 76.mm
  FRONT_Y = -THICK

  def material(model, name, rgb)
    mats = model.materials
    m = mats[name] || mats.add(name)
    m.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*rgb)
    m
  end

  def box(entities, name, x1, y1, z1, x2, y2, z2, mat)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name
    pts = [
      [x1,y1,z1], [x2,y1,z1],
      [x2,y2,z1], [x1,y2,z1]
    ].map { |p| Geom::Point3d.new(*p) }

    face = g.entities.add_face(pts)
    if face
      face.reverse! if face.normal.z < 0
      face.pushpull(z2 - z1)
      g.material = mat
      g.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |f|
        f.material = mat
        f.back_material = mat
      end
    end
    g
  end

  # Khối hộp với mặt trước quay về phía -Y
  def front_box(entities, name, x, z, width, height,
                depth, y, mat)
    box(
      entities, name,
      x, y, z,
      x + width, y + depth, z + height,
      mat
    )
  end

  # Trụ tròn đứng
  def cylinder(entities, name, x, y, z, radius, height, mat)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name
    center = Geom::Point3d.new(x, y, z)
    circle = g.entities.add_circle(
      center, Geom::Vector3d.new(0,0,1), radius, 32
    )
    face = g.entities.add_face(circle)
    if face
      face.reverse! if face.normal.z < 0
      face.pushpull(height)
      g.material = mat
      g.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |f|
        f.material = mat
        f.back_material = mat
      end
    end
    g
  end

  # Tạo chữ nổi trên mặt đứng XZ.
  # Chữ được tạo trên mặt phẳng XY, sau đó xoay 90 độ quanh X.
  def text3d(entities, label, x, z, height,
             font, color, depth = 8.mm,
             bold = true, italic = false,
             align = 0)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = "CHU_NOI_#{label.tr(" ", "_")}"
    e = g.entities

    begin
      e.add_3d_text(
        label,
        align,
        font,
        bold,
        italic,
        height,
        0.5.mm,
        depth,
        true
      )
    rescue => err
      puts "Loi tao chu #{label}: #{err.message}"
      return g
    end

    rotation = Geom::Transformation.rotation(
      ORIGIN, X_AXIS, 90.degrees
    )
    translation = Geom::Transformation.translation(
      Geom::Vector3d.new(x, FRONT_Y - 12.mm, z)
    )
    g.transformation = translation * rotation

    g.material = color
    e.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |f|
      f.material = color
      f.back_material = color
    end
    g
  end

  # Thanh phân cách đứng
  def separator(entities, x, z, height, mat)
    front_box(
      entities, "THANH_PHAN_CACH",
      x, z, 3.mm, height, 3.mm,
      FRONT_Y - 5.mm, mat
    )
  end

  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model

      # ---------------- TIÊU ĐỀ CHÍNH ----------------
      # Dòng chữ lớn màu trắng, font đậm nghiêng
      text3d(

      )

      # ---------------- THANH THÔNG TIN ----------------
      # Thanh nền trắng bo cảm giác bằng hai đầu tròn

# ============================================================

require 'sketchup.rb'

module XeDienThuHien3D
  extend self

  # ---------------- THÔNG SỐ MÔ HÌNH ----------------
  W       = 5000.mm
  H       = 1500.mm
  THICK   = 80.mm
  BOTTOM  = 2200.mm
  TOP     = BOTTOM + H
  POST_H  = 3900.mm
  POST_D  = 76.mm
  FRONT_Y = -THICK

  def material(model, name, rgb)
    mats = model.materials
    m = mats[name] || mats.add(name)
    m.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*rgb)
    m
  end

  def box(entities, name, x1, y1, z1, x2, y2, z2, mat)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name
    pts = [
      [x1,y1,z1], [x2,y1,z1],
      [x2,y2,z1], [x1,y2,z1]
    ].map { |p| Geom::Point3d.new(*p) }

    face = g.entities.add_face(pts)
    if face
      face.reverse! if face.normal.z < 0
      face.pushpull(z2 - z1)
      g.material = mat
      g.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |f|
        f.material = mat
        f.back_material = mat
      end
    end
    g
  end

  # Khối hộp với mặt trước quay về phía -Y
  def front_box(entities, name, x, z, width, height,
                depth, y, mat)
    box(
      entities, name,
      x, y, z,
      x + width, y + depth, z + height,
      mat
    )
  end

  # Trụ tròn đứng
  def cylinder(entities, name, x, y, z, radius, height, mat)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name
    center = Geom::Point3d.new(x, y, z)
    circle = g.entities.add_circle(
      center, Geom::Vector3d.new(0,0,1), radius, 32
    )
    face = g.entities.add_face(circle)
    if face
      face.reverse! if face.normal.z < 0
      face.pushpull(height)
      g.material = mat
      g.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |f|
        f.material = mat
        f.back_material = mat
      end
    end
    g
  end

  # Tạo chữ nổi trên mặt đứng XZ.
  # Chữ được tạo trên mặt phẳng XY, sau đó xoay 90 độ quanh X.
  def text3d(entities, label, x, z, height,
             font, color, depth = 8.mm,
             bold = true, italic = false,
             align = 0)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = "CHU_NOI_#{label.tr(" ", "_")}"
    e = g.entities

    begin
      e.add_3d_text(
        label,
        align,
        font,
        bold,
        italic,
        height,
        0.5.mm,
        depth,
        true
      )
    rescue => err
      puts "Loi tao chu #{label}: #{err.message}"
      return g
    end

    rotation = Geom::Transformation.rotation(
      ORIGIN, X_AXIS, 90.degrees
    )
    translation = Geom::Transformation.translation(
      Geom::Vector3d.new(x, FRONT_Y - 12.mm, z)
    )
    g.transformation = translation * rotation

    g.material = color
    e.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |f|
      f.material = color
      f.back_material = color
    end
    g
  end

  # Thanh phân cách đứng
  def separator(entities, x, z, height, mat)
    front_box(
      entities, "THANH_PHAN_CACH",
      x, z, 3.mm, height, 3.mm,
      FRONT_Y - 5.mm, mat
    )
  end

      root = model.active_entities.add_group

# ============================================================

module BunDauCoHau3D
  extend self

  # KICH THUOC BANG
  W = 4000.mm
  H = 1800.mm
  FRAME = 40.mm
  PANEL_D = 35.mm
  LETTER_D = 18.mm

  def material(name, rgb)
    mats = Sketchup.active_model.materials
    m = mats[name] || mats.add(name)
    m.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*rgb)
    m
  end

  def box(entities, name, x, y, z, w, h, d, mat)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name
    pts = [
      [x,y,z], [x+w,y,z], [x+w,y,z+h], [x,y,z+h]
    ].map { |p| Geom::Point3d.new(*p) }

    f = g.entities.add_face(pts)
    if f
      f.reverse! if f.normal.y > 0
      f.pushpull(d)
      g.material = mat
      g.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |face|
        face.material = mat
        face.back_material = mat
      end
    end
    g
  end

  # Chu noi tren mat dung, truc ngang X, truc cao Z
  def raised_text(entities, name, string, x, z,
                  height, width, face_mat,
                  font = "Arial", bold = true, depth = LETTER_D)

    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name

    begin
      g.entities.add_3d_text(
        string,
        TextAlignCenter,
        font,
        bold,
        false,
        height,
        0.5.mm,
        true,
        depth
      )
    rescue
      g.erase!
      return nil
    end

    b = g.bounds
    return g if b.width <= 0

    sx = width.to_f / b.width
    g.transform!(
      Geom::Transformation.scaling(
        Geom::Point3d.new(0,0,0), sx, 1, 1
      )
    )

    b = g.bounds
    cx = (b.min.x + b.max.x) / 2.0
    min_y = b.min.y

    g.transform!(
      Geom::Transformation.translation(
        Geom::Vector3d.new(-cx, -min_y, 0)
      )
    )

    # Xoay chu de mat chu huong ra phia truoc (-Y)
    g.transform!(
      Geom::Transformation.rotation(
        Geom::Point3d.new(0,0,0),
        Geom::Vector3d.new(1,0,0),
        90.degrees
      )
    )

    b = g.bounds
    g.transform!(
      Geom::Transformation.translation(
        Geom::Vector3d.new(x, -PANEL_D - depth, z - b.min.z)
      )
    )

    g.material = face_mat
    g.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |face|
      face.material = face_mat
      face.back_material = face_mat
    end
    g
  end

  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation("Bun Dau Co Hau 3D", true)

    begin
      root = model.active_entities.add_group
      root.name = "BANG HIEU BUN DAU CO HAU"
      e = root.entities

      black  = material("CDH Khung den", [20,20,24])
      teal   = material("CDH Ton xanh ngoc", [0,165,145])
      teal2  = material("CDH Ton song toi", [0,125,115])
      yellow = material("CDH Chu vang", [255,190,0])
      white  = material("CDH Chu trang", [245,243,255])
      orange = material("CDH Dia chi cam", [225,145,65])
      dark   = material("CDH Bong chu den", [18,16,25])

      # TAM BANG
      box(e, "Nen ton xanh ngoc",
          0, 0, 0, W, H, PANEL_D, teal)

      # TON SONG DOC - cac nep noi
      rib_count = 68
      rib_spacing = W.to_f / rib_count

      rib_count.times do |i|
        x = i * rib_spacing
        box(e, "Nep ton doc #{i+1}",
            x, -2.mm, 0,
            7.mm, H, 3.mm, teal2)
      end

      # KHUNG VIEN CHU NHAT
      box(e, "Vien tren", 0, -45.mm, H-FRAME,
          W, FRAME, 45.mm, black)
      box(e, "Vien duoi", 0, -45.mm, 0,
          W, FRAME, 45.mm, black)
      box(e, "Vien trai", 0, -45.mm, 0,
          FRAME, H, 45.mm, black)
      box(e, "Vien phai", W-FRAME, -45.mm, 0,
          FRAME, H, 45.mm, black)

      # DONG CHU CHINH
      raised_text(e, "Chu BUN",
          "BUN", 600.mm, 1190.mm,
          360.mm, 850.mm, white, "Arial", true, 22.mm)

      raised_text(e, "Chu DAU",
          "DAU", 1250.mm, 830.mm,
          310.mm, 850.mm, white, "Arial", true, 22.mm)

      raised_text(e, "Chu CO HAU",
          "CO HAU", 2220.mm, 850.mm,
          350.mm, 1550.mm, yellow, "Arial", true, 25.mm)

      # DONG PHU
      raised_text(e, "Huong vi Ha Thanh",
          "HUONG VI HA THANH",
          2050.mm, 440.mm,
          215.mm, 2350.mm,
          yellow, "Arial", true, 18.mm)

      # DIA CHI
      raised_text(e, "Dia chi",
          "2122 PHAM THE HIEN P6 Q8",
          1550.mm, 135.mm,
          100.mm, 2000.mm,
          orange, "Arial", true, 6.mm)

      # BIEU TUONG NHA DON GIAN
      # Mai nha
      roof = e.add_group
      roof.name = "Icon nha"
      pts = [
        [260.mm,-50.mm,190.mm],
        [390.mm,-50.mm,310.mm],
        [520.mm,-50.mm,190.mm]
      ].map { |p| Geom::Point3d.new(*p) }
      face = roof.entities.add_face(pts)
      face.material = orange if face

      box(e, "Than nha", 300.mm, -50.mm, 80.mm,
          180.mm, 120.mm, 6.mm, orange)

      # KHUNG GIA DO PHIA SAU
      box(e, "Thanh ngang sau",
          100.mm, 30.mm, 100.mm,
          W-200.mm, 50.mm, 50.mm, black)

      # XEM TOAN BO MO HINH
      model.active_view.zoom(root)
      model.commit_operation

      UI.messagebox(
        "Da dung xong bang hieu BUN DAU CO HAU 3D.\n" \
        "Kich thuoc: 4000 x 1800 mm.\n" \
        "Luu mo hinh bang File > Save As."
      )
    rescue => ex
      model.abort_operation
      UI.messagebox("Loi: #{ex.message}")
      raise ex
    end
  end

# ============================================================

require 'sketchup.rb'

module ADMAKE_COFFEE_SIGN

  extend self

  MODEL_NAME = "ADMAKE - Coffee Tea 10 - Highcut Vintage"

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. VẬT LIỆU
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def material(name, color, alpha = 1.0)
    mats = Sketchup.active_model.materials
    mat = mats[name] || mats.add(name)
    mat.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*color)
    mat.alpha = alpha
    mat
  end

  def materials
    {
      wall: material("Tuong - gach kem", [208, 201, 181]),
      brick: material("Mach gach", [125, 112, 96]),
      black: material("Chu noi - den", [24, 21, 18]),
      gold: material("Inox vang guong", [218, 164, 36]),
      gold_side: material("Canh chu - vang dong", [132, 91, 24]),
      warm: material("LED - vang am", [255, 190, 80]),
      white: material("Nen logo - trang", [242, 239, 226]),
      glass: material("Kinh - xam xanh", [80, 111, 115], 0.55),
      metal: material("Khung kim loai", [95, 99, 99]),
      red: material("Logo - do", [175, 20, 28])
    }
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. HÌNH HỘP 3D
  # Tọa độ: X ngang, Y chiều sâu, Z chiều cao
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def add_box(entities, name, x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, mat)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name
    e = g.entities

    p000 = Geom::Point3d.new(x,      y,      z)
    p100 = Geom::Point3d.new(x + dx, y,      z)
    p110 = Geom::Point3d.new(x + dx, y + dy, z)
    p010 = Geom::Point3d.new(x,      y + dy, z)

    p001 = Geom::Point3d.new(x,      y,      z + dz)
    p101 = Geom::Point3d.new(x + dx, y,      z + dz)
    p111 = Geom::Point3d.new(x + dx, y + dy, z + dz)
    p011 = Geom::Point3d.new(x,      y + dy, z + dz)

    faces = [
      [p000, p010, p110, p100],
      [p001, p101, p111, p011],
      [p000, p100, p101, p001],
      [p100, p110, p111, p101],
      [p110, p010, p011, p111],
      [p010, p000, p001, p011]
    ]

    faces.each do |pts|
      face = e.add_face(pts)
      next unless face
      face.material = mat
      face.back_material = mat
    end

    g
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. CHỮ NỔI 3D
  # Chữ nằm trên mặt đứng XZ, nhô ra phía trước theo -Y
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def add_text_3d(entities, name, text, x, y, z,
                  height, depth, front_mat, side_mat,
                  font = "Arial", bold = true)

    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name

    ok = g.entities.add_3d_text(
      text,
      Sketchup::TextAlignLeft,
      font,
      bold,
      false,
      height,
      1.mm,
      0,
      true,
      depth,
      front_mat
    )

    unless ok
      g.erase!
      return nil
    end

    # Tô vật liệu mặt sau/cạnh chữ
    g.entities.each do |entity|
      next unless entity.is_a?(Sketchup::Face)
      entity.back_material = side_mat
      entity.material ||= front_mat
    end

    # Đưa mặt phẳng chữ XY thành mặt đứng XZ.
    # Trục đùn Z của chữ hướng ra phía trước theo -Y.
    origin = Geom::Point3d.new(x, y, z)
    xaxis  = Geom::Vector3d.new(1, 0, 0)
    yaxis  = Geom::Vector3d.new(0, 0, 1)
    zaxis  = Geom::Vector3d.new(0, -1, 0)

    g.transformation = Geom::Transformation.axes(
      origin, xaxis, yaxis, zaxis
    )

    g
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 4. KHUNG / VIỀN TRANG TRÍ
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def add_frame(entities, x, y, z, w, h, bar, depth, mat, prefix)
    add_box(entities, "#{prefix} - Vien tren",
            x, y, z + h - bar, w, depth, bar, mat)

    add_box(entities, "#{prefix} - Vien duoi",
            x, y, z, w, depth, bar, mat)

    add_box(entities, "#{prefix} - Vien trai",
            x, y, z, bar, depth, h, mat)

    add_box(entities, "#{prefix} - Vien phai",
            x + w - bar, y, z, bar, depth, h, mat)
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 5. BIỂN COFFEE & TEA 10
  # Chữ nổi vàng trên mặt tường, có cạnh tối tạo tương phản
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def build_coffee_sign(root, m)
    g = root.add_group
    g.name = "01 - COFFEE & TEA 10"
    e = g.entities

    # Kích thước quy ước của cụm chữ phía trên
    x = -2450.mm
    y = -80.mm
    z = 4650.mm
    width = 4900.mm

    # Tấm nền tối mỏng phía sau chữ, có thể tắt nếu dùng
    # phương án chữ gắn trực tiếp lên tường.
    add_box(e, "Nen sau chu Coffee Tea",
            x, y + 45.mm, z - 100.mm,
            width, 20.mm, 760.mm, m[:black])

    # Thanh gá chữ
    add_box(e, "Thanh lap dat tren",
            x + 100.mm, y + 15.mm, z - 60.mm,
            width - 200.mm, 30.mm, 25.mm, m[:metal])

    # Chữ chính
    add_text_3d(
      e, "Chu Coffee Tea 10",
      "Coffee & Tea 10",
      x + 140.mm, y, z + 100.mm,
      420.mm, 35.mm,
      m[:gold], m[:black],
      "Arial", true
    )

    # Viền đế phụ trợ phía sau chữ
    add_box(e, "Nep chan chu",
            x + 120.mm, y + 5.mm, z - 20.mm,
            width - 240.mm, 12.mm, 22.mm, m[:gold_side])

    # Bát/vấu gá liên kết vào tường
    [x + 250.mm, 0, x + width - 250.mm].each_with_index do |px, i|
      add_box(e, "Pat treo Coffee #{i + 1}",
              px, 20.mm, z + 120.mm,
              60.mm, 100.mm, 160.mm, m[:metal])
    end

    g
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 6. BIỂN HIGHCUT VINTAGE
  # Chữ đen nổi, nền sáng và lớp hắt sáng vàng ấm
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def build_highcut_sign(root, m)
    g = root.add_group
    g.name = "02 - HIGHCUT VINTAGE"
    e = g.entities

    x = -2200.mm
    y = -100.mm
    z = 3150.mm
    w = 4400.mm
    h = 650.mm

    # Đế nền sáng
    add_box(e, "Nen bien Highcut",
            x, y + 40.mm, z,
            w, 50.mm, h, m[:white])

    # Hộp hắt sáng phía sau
    add_box(e, "Hop LED sau bien",
            x + 30.mm, y + 10.mm, z + 25.mm,
            w - 60.mm, 30.mm, h - 50.mm, m[:warm])

    # Mặt nền phía trước
    add_box(e, "Mat nen trang",
            x + 50.mm, y - 5.mm, z + 45.mm,
            w - 100.mm, 12.mm, h - 90.mm, m[:white])

    # Chữ nổi màu đen
    add_text_3d(
      e, "Chu Highcut Vintage",
      "Highcut Vintage",
      x + 170.mm, y - 20.mm, z + 170.mm,
      350.mm, 38.mm,
      m[:black], m[:black],
      "Arial", true
    )

    # Nẹp kim loại dưới biển
    add_box(e, "Nep duoi Highcut",
            x, y + 25.mm, z - 20.mm,
            w, 45.mm, 25.mm, m[:metal])

    # Pat liên kết
    [x + 250.mm, x + w / 2, x + w - 250.mm].each_with_index do |px, i|
      add_box(e, "Pat Highcut #{i + 1}",
              px, 15.mm, z + 80.mm,
              70.mm, 100.mm, 100.mm, m[:metal])
    end

    g
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 7. LOGO TRÒN COFFEE
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def add_cylinder_y(entities, name, cx, y, cz,
                     radius, depth, mat, segments = 64)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name

    # Tạo đường tròn nằm trên mặt XZ
    pts = []
    segments.times do |i|
      a = 2.0 * Math::PI * i / segments
      pts << Geom::Point3d.new(
        cx + radius * Math.cos(a),
        y,
        cz + radius * Math.sin(a)
      )
    end

    face = g.entities.add_face(pts)
    if face
      face.material = mat
      face.back_material = mat
      face.pushpull(depth)
    end

    g
  end

  def build_round_logo(root, m)
    g = root.add_group
    g.name = "03 - LOGO COFFEE TRON"
    e = g.entities

    cx = 3000.mm
    y = -100.mm
    cz = 3800.mm
    r = 440.mm

    add_cylinder_y(e, "Vien logo kim loai",
                   cx, y, cz, r, 45.mm, m[:black])

    add_cylinder_y(e, "Mat logo trang",
                   cx, y - 3.mm, cz, r - 35.mm,
                   8.mm, m[:white])

    add_text_3d(
      e, "Logo Coffee",
      "COFFEE",
      cx - 270.mm, y - 20.mm, cz - 50.mm,
      105.mm, 12.mm,
      m[:black], m[:black],
      "Arial", true
    )

    # Biểu tượng hạt cà phê cách điệu bằng hai hình elip
    add_cylinder_y(e, "Hat ca phe trai",
                   cx - 70.mm, y - 8.mm, cz + 130.mm,
                   65.mm, 10.mm, m[:gold], 32)

    add_cylinder_y(e, "Hat ca phe phai",
                   cx + 70.mm, y - 8.mm, cz + 130.mm,
                   65.mm, 10.mm, m[:gold], 32)

    g
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 8. TƯỜNG THAM CHIẾU, CỬA SỔ VÀ GẠCH
  # Dùng làm nền phối cảnh; có thể ẩn nhóm này khi xuất biển
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def build_wall(root, m)
    g = root.add_group
    g.name = "00 - WALL REFERENCE"
    e = g.entities

    # Tường tham chiếu
    add_box(e, "Khoi tuong",
            -4000.mm, 100.mm, 0,
            8000.mm, 250.mm, 6000.mm, m[:wall])

    # Mảng cửa kính tầng trên
    add_box(e, "Kinh tren trai",
            -1500.mm, 80.mm, 5050.mm,
            1050.mm, 25.mm, 700.mm, m[:glass])

    add_box(e, "Kinh tren phai",
            200.mm, 80.mm, 5050.mm,
            1050.mm, 25.mm, 700.mm, m[:glass])

    # Khung cửa sổ
    add_frame(e, -1550.mm, 60.mm, 5000.mm,
              1150.mm, 800.mm, 35.mm, 30.mm,
              m[:metal], "Khung kinh trai")

    add_frame(e, 150.mm, 60.mm, 5000.mm,
              1150.mm, 800.mm, 35.mm, 30.mm,
              m[:metal], "Khung kinh phai")

    # Các đường mạch gạch tham chiếu
    12.times do |i|
      zz = 200.mm + i * 280.mm
      add_box(e, "Mach gach #{i + 1}",
              -4000.mm, 95.mm, zz,
              8000.mm, 5.mm, 3.mm, m[:brick])
    end

    g
  end

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 9. CHẠY DỰNG MÔ HÌNH
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model

    model.start_operation("ADMAKE - Dung bien hieu 3D", true)

    begin
      m = materials

      # Nhóm tổng để quản lý toàn bộ mô hình
      root = model.active_entities.add_group
      root.name = MODEL_NAME
      e = root.entities

      # Tường tham chiếu
      build_wall(e, m)

      # Hai cụm biển chính
      build_coffee_sign(e, m)
      build_highcut_sign(e, m)
      build_round_logo(e, m)

      # Đưa camera nhìn toàn mô hình
      model.active_view.zoom_extents
      model.commit_operation

      UI.messagebox(
        "Đã dựng xong mô hình biển hiệu 3D.\\n" \
        "Các cấu kiện được nhóm riêng để chỉnh sửa.\\n" \
        "Kích thước là quy ước ban đầu, cần hiệu chỉnh theo đo đạc."
      )

    rescue => error
      model.abort_operation
      UI.messagebox(
        "Lỗi khi dựng mô hình:\\n#{error.message}\\n" \
        "#{error.backtrace.first}"
      )
    end
  end

  unless file_loaded?(__FILE__)
    UI.menu("Extensions").add_item(
      "ADMAKE - Dung bien Coffee Tea 10"
    ) {
      build
    }
    file_loaded(__FILE__)
  end

end

# ============================================================

module GoldLEDLetters
  extend self

  MODEL_NAME = "DEL_GOLD_LED_3D"

  # Dimensions (mm)
  LETTER_HEIGHT = 500.mm
  LETTER_DEPTH  = 100.mm
  SIDE_THICKNESS = 2.mm
  BORDER_WIDTH = 12.mm
  LED_RADIUS = 5.mm
  LED_SPACING = 25.mm
  LETTER_GAP = 35.mm

  def material(model, name, color, alpha = 1.0)
    mat = model.materials[name] || model.materials.add(name)
    mat.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*color)
    mat.alpha = alpha
    mat
  end

  def assign_materials(entities, front_mat, gold_mat)
    entities.each do |entity|
      next unless entity.is_a?(Sketchup::Face)

      entity.material =
        entity.normal.z > 0.8 ? front_mat : gold_mat

      entity.back_material = gold_mat
    end
  end

  def add_led_dot(entities, center, radius, mat)
    circle = entities.add_circle(
      center,
      Z_AXIS,
      radius,
      12
    )

    face = entities.add_face(circle)
    return unless face

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
  end

  def create_letter(model, character, x_position,
                    front_mat, gold_mat, led_mat)

    group = model.active_entities.add_group
    group.name = "LETTER_#{character}"

    entities = group.entities

    # Create extruded 3D text
    success = entities.add_3d_text(
      character,
      TextAlignCenter = 1,
      "Arial Black",
      true,
      false,
      LETTER_HEIGHT,
      0.5.mm,
      0,
      true,
      LETTER_DEPTH
    )

    unless success
      group.erase!
      return nil
    end

    # Apply gold and amber materials
    assign_materials(entities, front_mat, gold_mat)

    # Bounding box
    bounds = group.bounds
    min_x = bounds.min.x
    min_y = bounds.min.y
    min_z = bounds.min.z

    # Place the letter on the baseline

# ============================================================

module GoldLEDLetters
  extend self

  MODEL_NAME = "DEL_GOLD_LED_3D"

  # Dimensions (mm)
  LETTER_HEIGHT = 500.mm
  LETTER_DEPTH  = 100.mm
  SIDE_THICKNESS = 2.mm
  BORDER_WIDTH = 12.mm
  LED_RADIUS = 5.mm
  LED_SPACING = 25.mm
  LETTER_GAP = 35.mm

  def material(model, name, color, alpha = 1.0)
    mat = model.materials[name] || model.materials.add(name)
    mat.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*color)
    mat.alpha = alpha
    mat
  end

  def assign_materials(entities, front_mat, gold_mat)
    entities.each do |entity|
      next unless entity.is_a?(Sketchup::Face)

      entity.material =
        entity.normal.z > 0.8 ? front_mat : gold_mat

      entity.back_material = gold_mat
    end
  end

  def add_led_dot(entities, center, radius, mat)
    circle = entities.add_circle(
      center,
      Z_AXIS,
      radius,
      12
    )

    face = entities.add_face(circle)
    return unless face

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
  end

  def create_letter(model, character, x_position,
                    front_mat, gold_mat, led_mat)

    group = model.active_entities.add_group
    group.name = "LETTER_#{character}"

    entities = group.entities

    # Create extruded 3D text
    success = entities.add_3d_text(
      character,
      TextAlignCenter = 1,
      "Arial Black",
      true,
      false,
      LETTER_HEIGHT,
      0.5.mm,
      0,
      true,
      LETTER_DEPTH
    )

    unless success
      group.erase!
      return nil
    end

    # Apply gold and amber materials
    assign_materials(entities, front_mat, gold_mat)

    # Bounding box
    bounds = group.bounds
    min_x = bounds.min.x
    min_y = bounds.min.y
    min_z = bounds.min.z

    # Place the letter on the baseline
    group.transform!(
      Geom::Transformation.translation(
        Geom::Vector3d.new(
          x_position - min_x,
          -min_y,
          -min_z
        )
      )
    )

    # LED detail along the front perimeter approximation
    # The dots are placed around the outer bounding box.
    bounds = group.bounds
    z_front = bounds.max.z + 1.mm

    x0 = bounds.min.x
    x1 = bounds.max.x
    y0 = bounds.min.y
    y1 = bounds.max.y

    # Top and bottom rows
    x = x0 + LED_SPACING
    while x < x1 - LED_SPACING
      add_led_dot(
        model.active_entities,
        [x, y0, z_front],
        LED_RADIUS,
        led_mat
      )

      add_led_dot(
        model.active_entities,
        [x, y1, z_front],
        LED_RADIUS,
        led_mat
      )

      x += LED_SPACING
    end

    # Left and right rows
    y = y0 + LED_SPACING
    while y < y1 - LED_SPACING
      add_led_dot(
        model.active_entities,
        [x0, y, z_front],
        LED_RADIUS,
        led_mat
      )

      add_led_dot(
        model.active_entities,
        [x1, y, z_front],
        LED_RADIUS,
        led_mat
      )

      y += LED_SPACING
    end

    group
  end

  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model

    model.start_operation(
      "Create Gold LED 3D Letters",
      true
    )

    begin
      # Materials
      gold = material(
        model,
        "Gold_Mirror",
        [184, 134, 45]
      )

      amber = material(
        model,
        "Amber_Illuminated_Face",
        [255, 166, 20]
      )

      led = material(
        model,
        "Warm_White_LED",
        [255, 230, 130]
      )

      # Root group
      root = model.active_entities.add_group
      root.name = MODEL_NAME

      # Temporarily make root active for creating children
      model.active_entities.add_group

      # Build individual characters
      cursor = 0.0
      letters = ["D", "E", "L"]

      letters.each do |character|
        letter = root.entities.add_group
        letter.name = "LETTER_#{character}"

        result = letter.entities.add_3d_text(
          character,
          1,
          "Arial Black",
          true,
          false,
          LETTER_HEIGHT,
          0.5.mm,
          0,
          true,
          LETTER_DEPTH
        )

        if result
          assign_materials(
            letter.entities,
            amber,
            gold
          )

          bb = letter.bounds

          letter.transform!(
            Geom::Transformation.translation(
              Geom::Vector3d.new(
                cursor - bb.min.x,
                -bb.min.y,
                -bb.min.z
              )
            )
          )

          # Add luminous dots around each letter.
          bb = letter.bounds
          z = bb.max.z + 1.mm

          # Top and bottom rows
          px = bb.min.x + LED_SPACING

          while px < bb.max.x - LED_SPACING
            dot_group = root.entities.add_group
            c = dot_group.entities.add_circle(
              [px, bb.min.y, z],
              Z_AXIS,
              LED_RADIUS,
              12
            )

            f = dot_group.entities.add_face(c)
            if f
              f.material = led
              f.back_material = led
            end

            px += LED_SPACING
          end

          cursor += bb.width + LETTER_GAP
        end
      end

      # Remove the accidental empty group if present.
      model.active_entities.each do |entity|
        if entity.is_a?(Sketchup::Group) &&
           entity.entities.empty? &&
           entity != root
          entity.erase!
        end
      end

      model.selection.clear
      model.selection.add(root)
      model.active_view.zoom_extents

      model.commit_operation

      UI.messagebox(
        "Da tao mo hinh DEL 3D!\n" \
        "Chieu cao chu: 500 mm\n" \
        "Do day: 100 mm\n" \
        "Vat lieu: Gold + Amber LED"
      )

    rescue => e
      model.abort_operation
      UI.messagebox(
        "Loi tao mo hinh:\n#{e.message}\n#{e.backtrace.first}"
      )
    end
  end
end

    end
  end

  def add_led_dot(entities, center, radius, mat)
    circle = entities.add_circle(
      center,
      Z_AXIS,
      radius,
      12
    )

    face = entities.add_face(circle)
    return unless face

    face.material = mat
    face.back_material = mat
  end

  def create_letter(model, character, x_position,
                    front_mat, gold_mat, led_mat)

    group = model.active_entities.add_group
    group.name = "LETTER_#{character}"

    entities = group.entities

    # Create extruded 3D text
    success = entities.add_3d_text(
      character,
      TextAlignCenter = 1,
      "Arial Black",
      true,
      false,
      LETTER_HEIGHT,
      0.5.mm,
      0,
      true,
      LETTER_DEPTH
    )

    unless success
      group.erase!
      return nil
    end

    # Apply gold and amber materials
    assign_materials(entities, front_mat, gold_mat)

    # Bounding box
    bounds = group.bounds
    min_x = bounds.min.x
    min_y = bounds.min.y
    min_z = bounds.min.z

    # Place the letter on the baseline
    group.transform!(
      Geom::Transformation.translation(
        Geom::Vector3d.new(
          x_position - min_x,
          -min_y,
          -min_z
        )
      )
    )

    # LED detail along the front perimeter approximation
    # The dots are placed around the outer bounding box.
    bounds = group.bounds
    z_front = bounds.max.z + 1.mm

    x0 = bounds.min.x
    x1 = bounds.max.x
    y0 = bounds.min.y
    y1 = bounds.max.y

    # Top and bottom rows
    x = x0 + LED_SPACING
    while x < x1 - LED_SPACING
      add_led_dot(
        model.active_entities,
        [x, y0, z_front],
        LED_RADIUS,
        led_mat
      )

      add_led_dot(
        model.active_entities,
        [x, y1, z_front],
        LED_RADIUS,
        led_mat
      )

      x += LED_SPACING
    end

    # Left and right rows
    y = y0 + LED_SPACING
    while y < y1 - LED_SPACING
      add_led_dot(
        model.active_entities,
        [x0, y, z_front],
        LED_RADIUS,
        led_mat
      )

      add_led_dot(
        model.active_entities,
        [x1, y, z_front],
        LED_RADIUS,
        led_mat
      )

      y += LED_SPACING
    end

    group
  end

  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model

    model.start_operation(
      "Create Gold LED 3D Letters",
      true
    )

    begin
      # Materials
      gold = material(
        model,
        "Gold_Mirror",
        [184, 134, 45]
      )

      amber = material(
        model,
        "Amber_Illuminated_Face",
        [255, 166, 20]
      )

      led = material(
        model,
        "Warm_White_LED",
        [255, 230, 130]
      )

      # Root group
      root = model.active_entities.add_group
      root.name = MODEL_NAME

      # Temporarily make root active for creating children
      model.active_entities.add_group

      # Build individual characters
      cursor = 0.0
      letters = ["D", "E", "L"]

      letters.each do |character|
        letter = root.entities.add_group
        letter.name = "LETTER_#{character}"

        result = letter.entities.add_3d_text(
          character,
          1,
          "Arial Black",
          true,
          false,
          LETTER_HEIGHT,
          0.5.mm,
          0,
          true,
          LETTER_DEPTH
        )

        if result
          assign_materials(
            letter.entities,
            amber,
            gold
          )

          bb = letter.bounds

          letter.transform!(
            Geom::Transformation.translation(
              Geom::Vector3d.new(
                cursor - bb.min.x,
                -bb.min.y,
                -bb.min.z
              )
            )
          )

          # Add luminous dots around each letter.
          bb = letter.bounds
          z = bb.max.z + 1.mm

          # Top and bottom rows
          px = bb.min.x + LED_SPACING

          while px < bb.max.x - LED_SPACING
            dot_group = root.entities.add_group
            c = dot_group.entities.add_circle(
              [px, bb.min.y, z],
              Z_AXIS,
              LED_RADIUS,
              12
            )

            f = dot_group.entities.add_face(c)
            if f
              f.material = led
              f.back_material = led
            end

            px += LED_SPACING
          end

          cursor += bb.width + LETTER_GAP
        end
      end

      # Remove the accidental empty group if present.
      model.active_entities.each do |entity|
        if entity.is_a?(Sketchup::Group) &&
           entity.entities.empty? &&
           entity != root
          entity.erase!
        end
      end

      model.selection.clear
      model.selection.add(root)
      model.active_view.zoom_extents

      model.commit_operation

      UI.messagebox(
        "Da tao mo hinh DEL 3D!\n" \
        "Chieu cao chu: 500 mm\n" \
        "Do day: 100 mm\n" \
        "Vat lieu: Gold + Amber LED"
      )

    rescue => e
      model.abort_operation
      UI.messagebox(
        "Loi tao mo hinh:\n#{e.message}\n#{e.backtrace.first}"
      )
    end
  end
end

# ============================================================

module SachJuice3D
  extend self

  def mat(model, name, rgb)
    m = model.materials[name] || model.materials.add(name)
    m.color = Sketchup::Color.new(*rgb)
    m
  end

  def beam(entities, name, p1, p2, width, depth, material)
    a = Geom::Point3d.new(*p1)
    b = Geom::Point3d.new(*p2)
    v = b - a
    return if v.length < 0.01

    z_axis = v.clone
    z_axis.normalize!

    ref = Geom::Vector3d.new(0, 1, 0)
    ref = Geom::Vector3d.new(1, 0, 0) if z_axis.parallel?(ref)

    x_axis = z_axis.cross(ref)
    x_axis.normalize!
    y_axis = z_axis.cross(x_axis)
    y_axis.normalize!

    tr = Geom::Transformation.axes(a, x_axis, y_axis, z_axis)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name

    pts = [
      [-width / 2.0, -depth / 2.0, 0],
      [ width / 2.0, -depth / 2.0, 0],
      [ width / 2.0,  depth / 2.0, 0],
      [-width / 2.0,  depth / 2.0, 0]
    ].map { |p| Geom::Point3d.new(*p).transform(tr) }

    f = g.entities.add_face(pts)
    f.reverse! if f && f.normal.dot(z_axis) < 0
    f.pushpull(v.length) if f
    g.material = material
    g.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |face|
      face.material = material
      face.back_material = material
    end
    g
  end

  def box(entities, name, x, y, z, sx, sy, sz, material)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name
    pts = [
      [x, y, z], [x + sx, y, z],
      [x + sx, y + sy, z], [x, y + sy, z]
    ].map { |p| Geom::Point3d.new(*p) }
    f = g.entities.add_face(pts)
    f.reverse! if f && f.normal.z < 0
    f.pushpull(sz) if f
    g.material = material
    g.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |face|
      face.material = material
      face.back_material = material
    end
    g
  end

  def panel(entities, name, points, y, thickness, material)
    g = entities.add_group
    g.name = name
    pts = points.map { |x, z| Geom::Point3d.new(x, y, z) }
    f = g.entities.add_face(pts)
    raise "Khong tao duoc mat #{name}" unless f
    f.reverse! if f.normal.y > 0
    f.pushpull(thickness)
    g.material = material
    g.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |face|
      face.material = material
      face.back_material = material
    end
    g
  end

  def run
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('Sach Juice Sign 3D', true)

    begin
      root = model.active_entities.add_group
      root.name = 'SACH JUICE - COMPLETE SIGN'
      e = root.entities

      black  = mat(model, 'SJ Black Steel', [25, 27, 31])
      white  = mat(model, 'SJ White Acrylic', [248, 247, 250])
      pink   = mat(model, 'SJ Juice Pink', [230, 28, 100])
      green  = mat(model, 'SJ Leaf Green', [85, 190, 100])
      yellow = mat(model, 'SJ Fruit Yellow', [250, 202, 28])
      red    = mat(model, 'SJ Red Label', [220, 22, 48])
      blue   = mat(model, 'SJ Blue Accent', [30, 95, 190])

      # 1. BASE: 650 x 500 mm
      box(e, 'Base front rail', 0, 0, 20, 650, 40, 40, black)
      box(e, 'Base rear rail', 0, 460, 20, 650, 40, 40, black)
      box(e, 'Base left rail', 0, 40, 20, 40, 420, 40, black)
      box(e, 'Base right rail', 610, 40, 20, 40, 420, 40, black)
      box(e, 'Base crossbar 1', 120, 40, 20, 40, 420, 40, black)
      box(e, 'Base crossbar 2', 490, 40, 20, 40, 420, 40, black)

      # 2. UPRIGHTS AND BRACING
      box(e, 'Left upright', 160, 205, 60, 40, 40, 1350, black)
      box(e, 'Right upright', 450, 205, 60, 40, 40, 1350, black)

      beam(e, 'Left diagonal brace',
           [180, 220, 150], [290, 220, 1370], 35, 35, black)
      beam(e, 'Right diagonal brace',
           [470, 220, 150], [360, 220, 1370], 35, 35, black)
      beam(e, 'Top support',
           [180, 220, 1370], [470, 220, 1370], 40, 40, black)

      # 3. SIGN BODY: rounded-top silhouette
      outline = [
        [100, 2240], [100, 2500], [120, 2580],
        [165, 2650], [220, 2705], [290, 2730],
        [360, 2705], [415, 2650], [460, 2580],
        [480, 2500], [480, 2240], [445, 2110],
        [405, 1950], [365, 1780], [330, 1620],
        [290, 1530], [250, 1620], [215, 1780],
        [175, 1950], [135, 2110]
      ]

      panel(e, 'Black outer casing', outline, 160, 85, black)
      panel(e, 'White front acrylic', outline, 155, 8, white)

      # 4. GRAPHIC PANELS
      # Main pink juice cup, represented as a separate solid panel
      cup = [
        [195, 2110], [380, 2110], [360, 1810],
        [325, 1690], [250, 1690], [215, 1810]
      ]
      panel(e, 'Pink juice graphic', cup, 142, 4, pink)

      # Decorative leaf shapes
      panel(e, 'Left leaf', [
        [115, 2070], [165, 2140], [190, 2040],
        [160, 1990], [130, 2015]
      ], 136, 4, green)

      panel(e, 'Right leaf', [
        [385, 2070], [435, 2140], [450, 2015],
        [420, 1990], [390, 2040]
      ], 136, 4, green)

      # Red product label
      panel(e, 'Red juice label', [
        [205, 2050], [375, 2050],
        [365, 1970], [215, 1970]
      ], 132, 4, red)

      # Yellow fruit accents
      [[225, 1740], [250, 1715], [350, 1745], [365, 1775]].each_with_index do |p, i|
        cx, cz = p
        points = (0..23).map do |k|
          angle = 2.0 * Math::PI * k / 24
          [cx + 18 * Math.cos(angle), cz + 18 * Math.sin(angle)]
        end
        panel(e, "Fruit accent #{i + 1}", points, 130, 5, yellow)
      end

      # 5. TEXT: editable 3D text entities
      # Exact fonts depend on fonts installed on the computer.
      def add_text(entities, name, string, point, height, material)
        g = entities.add_group
        g.name = name
        text = g.entities.add_3d_text(
          string,
          TextAlignCenter = 1,
          'Arial',
          false,
          true,
          height,
          0.0,
          0.0,
          true,
          1.5
        )
        g.material = material
        g.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |face|
          face.material = material
          face.back_material = material
        end
        g.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation(
          Geom::Point3d.new(*point)
        ))
        g
      end

      # Text on front plane: horizontal text uses the X axis.
      add_text(e, 'Brand title', 'Sach Juice',
               [290, 120, 2460], 58, green)
      add_text(e, 'Drink subtitle', 'Nuoc ep Detox',
               [290, 115, 2020], 30, white)

      # 6. FOOT / MOUNTING PLATES
      box(e, 'Left mounting plate', 155, 195, 55, 60, 60, 10, black)
      box(e, 'Right mounting plate', 435, 195, 55, 60, 60, 10, black)

      # 7. CAMERA AND VIEW
      model.active_view.zoom_extents
      model.commit_operation

      UI.messagebox(
        "Da tao mo hinh Sach Juice 3D.\n" \
        "Kich thuoc va hinh in la mo phong tham khao."
      )
    rescue => err
      model.abort_operation
      UI.messagebox("Loi tao mo hinh: #{err.message}\n#{err.backtrace.first}")
    end
  end
end

module StandeeChanChuX60X160
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('StandeeChanChuX60X160', true)
    entities = model.active_entities

    # Tạo khung đỡ
    base_width = 600.mm
    base_height = 1600.mm
    base_depth = 30.mm
    leg_depth = 30.mm
    leg_height = 1000.mm
    leg_width = 20.mm

    # Tạo khung chân chữ X

    leg1.name = "Leg1"
    leg1_face = leg1.entities.add_face([0, 0, 0], [leg_width, 0, 0], [leg_width, leg_depth, 0], [0, leg_depth, 0])
    leg1_face.pushpull(leg_height)

    leg2 = entities.add_group
    leg2.name = "Leg2"
    leg2_face = leg2.entities.add_face([base_width - leg_width, 0, 0], [base_width, 0, 0], [base_width, leg_depth, 0], [base_width - leg_width, leg_depth, 0])
    leg2_face.pushpull(leg_height)

    # Tạo bề mặt biển quảng cáo
    surface = entities.add_group
    surface.name = "Surface"
    surface_face = surface.entities.add_face([0, 0, leg_height], [base_width, 0, leg_height], [base_width, base_depth, leg_height], [0, base_depth, leg_height])
    surface_face.pushpull(-base_depth)

    # Gán màu cho các nhóm
    leg1.material = "Gray"
    leg2.material = "Gray"
    surface.material = "White"

    # Thêm chữ nổi 3D

    text_group.name = "Text"
    text = text_group.entities.add_3d_text("Standee", TextAlignCenter, "Arial", true, false, 100.mm, 1.mm, false)
    text_group.transform!(Geom::Transformation.new([base_width / 2 - 50.mm, base_depth / 2 - 20.mm, leg_height + 10.mm]))

    model.commit_operation
  end
end
